en.headline: Observatory records 36.8°C, hottest day since records began in 1884
en.dek: Under Severe Typhoon Dolphin’s outer subsiding air, the Hong Kong Observatory headquarters reached a new all-time high of 36.8 degrees Celsius on Sunday afternoon, while Happy Valley hit 38 degrees.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory recorded a maximum temperature of 36.8 degrees Celsius at its headquarters by early afternoon on Sunday, the highest reading since continuous records began in 1884 and surpassing the previous all-time mark of 36.6 degrees set on 22 August 2017.

Severe Typhoon Dolphin’s outer subsiding airflow brought prolonged fine and extremely hot conditions across Guangdong and Hong Kong. By 2 p.m. the Observatory stood at 36 degrees with relative humidity of 48 per cent; Happy Valley reached 38 degrees, while Tseung Kwan O, Tsuen Wan Shing Mun Valley, Wong Tai Sin, Kwun Tong and Yuen Long Park all logged 37 degrees.

The Very Hot Weather Warning remains in force. The Observatory expects the extreme heat to continue through Tuesday, with some areas still reaching 37 degrees or above, before temperatures ease slightly later in the week as a southwesterly airstream arrives. Residents were urged to drink plenty of water, avoid prolonged outdoor activity and seek medical help if feeling unwell.

zh.headline: 天文台錄36.8度破有紀錄最高溫 跑馬地見38度
zh.dek: 受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，天文台總部周日下午錄得36.8度，刷新1884年有紀錄以來最高氣溫，跑馬地更高見38度。
body: 香港天文台表示，周日下午早段總部錄得最高氣溫36.8度，是1884年有連續紀錄以來的最高讀數，亦超越2017年8月22日的36.6度舊紀錄。
強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流令華南及本港持續天晴極端酷熱。下午2時天文台氣溫仍有36度、相對濕度48%；跑馬地錄得38度，將軍澳、荃灣城門谷、黃大仙、觀塘及元朗公園均見37度。
酷熱天氣警告仍然生效。天文台預料極端酷熱天氣將持續至周二，部分地區氣溫仍可達37度或以上；其後西南氣流影響，氣溫稍為回落。市民應多補充水分，避免長時間戶外活動，如感不適盡快求醫。
